mn56:16.1: anuviccakāraṃ kho gahapati karohi. anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotīti.
mn56:16.2: iminā’pahaṃ bhante bhagavato bhiyyosomattāya attamano abhiraddho, yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha: anuviccakāraṃ kho gahapati karohi. anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotīti.
mn56:16.3: maṃ hi bhante aññatitthiyā sāvakaṃ labhitvā kevalakappaṃ nālandaṃ paṭākaṃ parihareyyuṃ:
mn56:16.5: atha ca pana maṃ bhagavā evamāha:
mn56:16.6: anuviccakāraṃ kho gahapati karohi, anuviccakāro tumhādisānaṃ ñātamanussānaṃ sādhu hotīti.
mn56:16.7: esāhambhante dutiyampi bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn56:16.8: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
mn56:17.1: dīgharattaṃ kho te gahapati nigaṇṭhānaṃ opānabhūtaṃ kulaṃ, yena nesaṃ upagatānaṃ piṇḍakaṃ dātabbaṃ maññeyyāsīti.
mn56:17.2: imināpahaṃ bhante bhagavato bhiyyosomattāya attamano abhiraddho yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha: dīgharattaṃ kho te gahapati nigaṇṭhānaṃ opānabhūtaṃ kulaṃ, yena nesaṃ upagatānaṃ piṇḍakaṃ dātabbaṃ maññeyyāsīti-
mn56:17.3: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante. samaṇo gotamo evamāha:
mn56:17.4: mayhameva dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, nāññesaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ,
mn56:17.5: mayhameva sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, nāññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ,
mn56:17.6: mayhameva dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, nāññesaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ,
mn56:17.7: mayhameva sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, nāññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalanti.
mn56:17.8: atha ca pana maṃ bhagavā nigaṇṭhesupi dāne samādapeti.
mn56:17.9: api ca bhante mayamettha kālaṃ jānissāma.
mn56:17.10: esāhambhante tatiyampi bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn56:17.11: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
mn56:18.1: atha kho bhagavā upālissa gahapatissa anupubbīkathaṃ kathesi. seyyathidaṃ:
mn56:18.2: dānakathaṃ, sīlakathaṃ, saggakathaṃ, kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ, okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ, nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
mn56:18.3: yadā bhagavā aññāsi upāliṃ gahapatiṃ kallacittaṃ muducittaṃ vinīvaraṇacittaṃ udaggacittaṃ pasannacittaṃ, atha yā buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhammadesanā, taṃ pakāsesi:
mn56:18.5: seyyathāpi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ sammadeva rajanaṃ patigaṇheyya.
mn56:18.6: evamevaṃ upālissa gahapatissa tasmiṃyeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
mn56:18.8: atha kho upāli gahapati diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṅkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:18.9: handa ca’dāni mayaṃ bhante gacchāma. bahukiccā mayaṃ bahukaraṇīyāti.
mn56:19.1: atha kho upāli gahapati bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena sakaṃ nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā dovārikaṃ āmantesi:
mn56:19.2: ajjatagge samma dovārika, āvarāmi dvāraṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ nigaṇṭhīnaṃ, anāvaṭaṃ dvāraṃ bhagavato bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ,
mn56:19.3: sace koci nigaṇṭho āgacchati. tamenaṃ tvaṃ evaṃ vadeyyāsi:
mn56:19.5: ajjatagge upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagato.
mn56:19.6: āvaṭaṃ dvāraṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ, nigaṇṭhīnaṃ, anāvaṭaṃ dvāraṃ bhagavato bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ.
mn56:19.7: sace te bhante piṇḍakena attho ettheva tiṭṭha, ettheva te āharissantīti.
mn56:19.8: evaṃ bhanteti kho dovāriko upālissa gahapatissa paccassosi.
mn56:20.2: upāli kira gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagatoti.
mn56:20.3: atha kho dīghatapassī nigaṇṭho yena nigaṇṭho nātaputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:20.4: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante upāli kira gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagatoti.
mn56:20.5: aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ tapassi anavakāso yaṃ upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagaccheyya.
mn56:20.6: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ samaṇo gotamo upālissa gahapatissa sāvakattaṃ upagaccheyyāti.
mn56:20.8: tatiyampi kho dīghatapassī nigaṇṭho nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:20.10: upāli kira gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagatoti. aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ tapassī anavakāso yaṃ upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagaccheyya. ṭhānañca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ samaṇo gotamo
mn56:20.12: handa cāhaṃ bhante gacchāmi yāva jānāmi yadi vā upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagato yadi vā noti.
mn56:20.13: gaccha tvaṃ tapassi jānāhi yadi vā upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagato yadi vā noti.
mn56:21.1: atha kho dīghatapassī nigaṇṭho yena upālissa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami.
mn56:21.2: addasā kho dovāriko dīghatapassiṃ nigaṇṭhaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
mn56:21.5: ajjatagge upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagato,
mn56:21.6: āvaṭaṃ dvāraṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ nigaṇṭhīnaṃ, anāvaṭaṃ dvāraṃ bhagavato bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ
mn56:21.7: sace te, bhante, piṇḍakena attho, ettheva tiṭṭha. ettheva te āharissantīti.
mn56:21.8: na me āvuso piṇḍakena atthoti vatvā tato paṭinivattitvā yena nigaṇṭho nātaputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:21.9: saccaṃyeva kho bhante yaṃ upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagato.
mn56:21.10: etaṃ kho te ahaṃ bhante nālatthaṃ: na kho metaṃ bhante ruccati yaṃ upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa vādaṃ āropeyya.
mn56:21.11: samaṇo hi bhante gotamo māyāvī. āvaṭṭaniṃ māyaṃ jānāti, yāya aññatitthiyānaṃ sāvake āvaṭṭetīti.
mn56:21.12: āvaṭṭo kho te bhante upāli gahapati samaṇena gotamena āvaṭṭaniyā māyāyāti.
mn56:21.13: aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ tapassi anavakāso yaṃ upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagaccheyya.
mn56:21.14: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ samaṇo gotamo upālissa gahapatissa sāvakattaṃ upagaccheyyāti.
mn56:21.18: tatiyampi kho dīghatapassī nigaṇṭho nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:21.20: yaṃ upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagato: etaṃ kho te ahaṃ bhante nālatthaṃ: na kho metaṃ bhante ruccati, yaṃ upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa vādaṃ āropeyya. samaṇo hi bhante gotamo māyāvī. āvaṭṭaniṃ māyaṃ jānāti, yāya aññatitthiyānaṃ sāvake āvaṭṭetīti. āvaṭṭo kho te bhante upāli gahapati samaṇena gotamena āvaṭṭaniyā māyāyāti. aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ tapassi anavakāso yaṃ upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagaccheyya ṭhānañca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ samaṇo gotamo
mn56:21.22: handa cāhaṃ tapassi gacchāmi yāya sāmaṃ yeva jānāmi. yadi vā upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagato yadi vā noti.
mn56:22.1: atha kho nigaṇṭho nātaputto mahatiyā nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhiṃ yena upālissa gahapatissa nivesanaṃ tenupasaṅkami.
mn56:22.2: addasā kho dovāriko nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ,
mn56:22.5: ajjatagge upāli gahapati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagato,
mn56:22.6: āvaṭaṃ dvāraṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ nigaṇṭhīnaṃ, anāvaṭaṃ dvāraṃ bhagavato bhikkhūnaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ upāsakānaṃ upāsikānaṃ.
mn56:22.7: sace te bhante piṇḍakena attho ettheva tiṭṭha. ettheva te āharissantīti.
mn56:22.8: tena hi samma dovārika, yena upāli gahapati tenupasaṅkama. upasaṅkamitvā upāliṃ gahapatiṃ evaṃ vadehi:
mn56:22.9: nigaṇṭho bhante nātaputto mahatiyā nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhiṃ bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhito.
mn56:22.11: evaṃ bhanteti kho dovāriko nigaṇṭhassa nātaputtassa paṭissutvā yena upāli gahapati tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā upāliṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
mn56:22.12: nigaṇṭho bhante nātaputto mahatiyā nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhiṃ bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhito,
mn56:22.14: tena hi samma dovārika, majjhimāya dvārasālāya āsanāni paññāpehīti.
mn56:22.15: evaṃ bhanteti kho dovāriko upālissa gahapatissa paṭissutvā majjhimāya dvārasālāya āsanāni paññapetvā yena upāli gahapati tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā upāliṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
mn56:22.16: paññattāni kho te bhante majjhimāya dvārasālāya āsanāni.
mn56:23.1: atha kho upāli gahapati yena majjhimā dvārasālā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā yaṃ tattha āsanaṃ aggañca seṭṭhañca uttamañca paṇītañca tattha nisīditvā dovārikaṃ āmantesi:
mn56:23.2: tena hi samma dovārika, yena nigaṇṭho nātaputto tenupasaṅkama. upasaṅkamitvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
mn56:23.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho dovāriko upālissa gahapatissa paṭissutvā yena nigaṇṭho nātaputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:23.8: atha kho nigaṇṭho nātaputto mahatiyā nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhiṃ yena majjhimā dvārasālā tenupasaṅkami.
mn56:24.2: yaṃ sudaṃ pubbeva yato passati nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ. disvāna tato paccugantvā yaṃ tattha āsanaṃ aggañca seṭṭhañca uttamañca paṇītañca, taṃ uttarāsaṅgena pamajjitvā pariggahetvā nisīdāpeti. so’dāni
mn56:24.3: yaṃ tattha āsanaṃ aggañca seṭṭhañca uttamañca paṇītañca tattha sāmaṃ nisīditvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:25.1: evaṃ vutte nigaṇṭho nātaputto upāliṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
mn56:25.2: ummattosi tvaṃ gahapati, dattosi tvaṃ gahapati.
mn56:25.3: gacchāmahaṃ bhante samaṇassa gotamassa vādaṃ āropessāmīti gantvā mahatāsi vādasaṅghāṭena paṭimukko āgato.
mn56:25.4: seyyathāpi gahapati puriso aṇḍahārako gantvā ubbhatehi aṇḍehi āgaccheyya, seyyathāpi vā pana gahapati puriso akkhihārako gantvā ubbhatehi akkhīhi āgaccheyya.
mn56:25.5: evameva kho tvaṃ gahapati gacchāmahaṃ bhante samaṇassa gotamassa vādaṃ āropessāmīti gantvā mahatāsi vādasaṅghāṭena paṭimukko āgato.
mn56:25.6: āvaṭṭosi kho tvaṃ gahapati samaṇena gotamena āvaṭṭaniyā māyāyāti.
mn56:26.3: piyā me bhante ñātisālohitā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ, piyānampi me assa ñātisālohitānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn56:26.4: sabbe cepi bhante khattiyā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ. sabbesānampissa khattiyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya. sabbe cepi bhante brāhmaṇā …pe… vessā …pe… suddā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ, sabbesānampissa suddānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn56:26.5: sadevako cepi bhante loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇī pajā sadevamanussā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyya, sadevakassapissa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
mn56:26.7: upamāyapidhekacce viññū purisā bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānanti.
mn56:27.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhante aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa jiṇṇassa vuddhassa mahallakassa daharā māṇavikā pajāpatī ahosi gabbhinī upavijaññā.
mn56:27.2: atha kho bhante sā māṇavikā taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:27.3: gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇa, āpaṇā makkaṭacchāpakaṃ kiṇitvā ānehi yo me kumārakassa kīḷāpanako bhavissatīti.
mn56:27.4: evaṃ vutte bhante so brāhmaṇo taṃ māṇavikaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:27.6: sace tvaṃ bhoti kumārakaṃ vijāyissasi, tassa te ahaṃ āpaṇā makkaṭacchāpakaṃ kiṇitvā ānessāmi. yo te kumārakassa kīḷāpanako bhavissati.
mn56:27.7: sace pana tvaṃ bhoti kumārikaṃ vijāyissasi, tassā te ahaṃ āpaṇā makkaṭacchāpikaṃ kiṇitvā ānessāmi. yā te kumārikāya kīḷāpanikā bhavissatīti.
mn56:27.9: tatiyampi kho bhante sā māṇavikā taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:27.10: gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇa āpaṇā makkaṭacchāpakaṃ kiṇitvā ānehi yo me kumārakassa kīḷāpanako bhavissatīti.
mn56:27.11: atha kho bhante so brāhmaṇo tassā māṇavikāya sāratto paṭibaddhacitto āpaṇā makkaṭacchāpakaṃ kiṇitvā ānetvā taṃ māṇavikaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:27.12: ayaṃ te bhoti āpaṇā makkaṭacchāpako kiṇitvā ānīto yo te kumārakassa kīḷāpanako bhavissatīti.
mn56:27.13: evaṃ vutte bhante sā māṇavikā taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:27.14: gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇa, imaṃ makkaṭacchāpakaṃ ādāya yena rattapāṇī rajakaputto tenupasaṅkama. upasaṅkamitvā rattapāṇiṃ rajakaputtaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
mn56:27.15: icchāmahaṃ samma rattapāṇī, imaṃ makkaṭacchāpakaṃ pītāvalepanaṃ nāma raṅgajātaṃ rañjitaṃ ākoṭitapaccākoṭitaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhanti.
mn56:27.16: atha kho bhante so brāhmaṇo tassā māṇavikāya sāratto paṭibaddhacitto taṃ makkaṭacchāpakaṃ ādāya yena rattapāṇī rajakaputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā rattapāṇiṃ rajakaputtaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:27.17: icchāmahaṃ samma rattapāṇī, imaṃ makkaṭacchāpakaṃ pītāvalepanaṃ nāma raṅgajātaṃ rañjitaṃ ākoṭitapaccākoṭitaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhanti.
mn56:27.18: evaṃ vutte bhante rattapāṇī rajakaputto taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:27.19: ayaṃ kho te bhante makkaṭacchāpako raṅgakkhamo hi kho, no ākoṭanakkhamo no vimajjanakkhamoti.
mn56:27.20: evameva kho bhante bālānaṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ vādo raṅgakkhamo hi kho bālānaṃ no paṇḍitānaṃ, no anuyogakkhamo, no vimajjanakkhamo.
mn56:27.21: atha kho bhante so brāhmaṇo aparena samayena navaṃ dussayugaṃ ādāya yena rattapāṇī rajakaputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā rattapāṇiṃ rajakaputtaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:27.22: icchāmahaṃ samma rattapāṇī, imaṃ navaṃ dussayugaṃ pītāvalepanaṃ nāma raṅgajātaṃ rañjitaṃ ākoṭitapaccākoṭitaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhanti.
mn56:27.23: evaṃ vutte bhante rattapāṇī rajakaputto taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:27.24: idaṃ kho te bhante navaṃ dussayugaṃ raṅgakkhamañceva ākoṭanakkhamañca vimajjanakkhamañcāti.
mn56:27.25: evameva kho bhante tassa bhagavato vādo arahato sammāsambuddhassa raṅgakkhamo ceva paṇḍitānaṃ no bālānaṃ, anuyogakkhamo ca vimajjanakkhamo cāti.
mn56:28.1: sarājikā kho taṃ gahapati parisā evaṃ jānāti:
mn56:29.1: evaṃ vutte upāli gahapati uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā tenañjalimpaṇāmetvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nātaputtaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:29.2: tena hi bhante suṇohi yassā’haṃ sāvako:
mn56:30.1: kadā saññūḷhā pana te gahapati ime samaṇassa gotamassa vaṇṇāti.
mn56:30.2: seyyathāpi bhante nānāpupphānaṃ mahāpuppharāsi, tamenaṃ dakkho mālākāro vā mālākārantevāsī vā vicittaṃ mālaṃ gantheyya.
mn56:30.3: evameva kho bhante so bhagavā anekavaṇṇo anekasatavaṇṇo
mn56:30.4: ko hi bhante vaṇṇārahassa vaṇṇaṃ na karissatīti.
mn56:31.1: atha kho nigaṇṭhassa bhagavato sakkāraṃ asahamānassa tattheva uṇhaṃ lohitaṃ mukhato uggañjīti.
